# Getting Support with Eko ✦

Thank you for using Eko! Here are the best ways to get help, ask questions, or report issues:

---

## 📖 Documentation & Guides

Before opening an issue, check out our official documentation:
- 🌐 **[Eko Documentation Website](https://kavix.github.io/eko)**
- 📖 **[Eko User Guide](guide.md)**
- 🤝 **[Contributing Guide](CONTRIBUTING.md)**
- 🌟 **[Good First Issues](GOOD_FIRST_ISSUES.md)**

---

## ❓ Frequently Asked Questions & Discussions

- **Asking Questions**: Have a question about how Eko works, AI providers, or feature requests? Open a topic on [GitHub Discussions](https://github.com/kavix/eko/discussions).
- **Found a Bug?**: Please search existing [GitHub Issues](https://github.com/kavix/eko/issues) before opening a new bug report to avoid duplicates.

---

## 🐞 Reporting Bugs & Requesting Features

If you run into bugs or have an idea for a feature:
1. Go to [New Issue](https://github.com/kavix/eko/issues/new/choose).
2. Choose **Bug Report** or **Feature Request**.
3. Fill out the details including your Go version, OS, and step-by-step reproduction steps.

Thank you for supporting the Eko community! ✦
